action_items.area: perspective: projection longer than the rest length
action_items.change: L is now the rest projection (correct at rest), but a limb that comes toward the camera is magnified and its projection exceeds L (ratio up to 1.33). Depth is then clipped to 0 and the limb is laid flat in the image plane exactly when it points at the camera. Model perspective: scale each joint's image offset by (Z_cam + z)/Z_cam with Z_cam from the actor's pixel height and a nominal focal length, iterate 2-3 times.

action_items.fail: df1e knee still > 30 deg in the hold.

action_items.area: depth sign still flips when the tracker is 'confident'
action_items.change: Sign continuity only applies while |tracker dz| < 0.3 L. When the tracker itself flips with a large depth (arms crossing in 0663, kick in df1e), the rebuilt joint still jumps 36-47 cm in one frame. Keep the previous sign unless the opposite sign persists for >= 3 frames, or choose the whole sign sequence per segment by dynamic programming (cost = depth jump + joint-limit violation, e.g. elbow/knee bending backwards).
action_items.expected: no rebuilt depth jump > 10 cm/frame (depth_rebuild_diagnostics); 0663 hand_l peak < 10000 deg/s^2.
action_items.evidence: 0663 sign flips f28/31/32/39, jumps 41.8 / 46.9 / 36.1 cm -> hand_l 103718 deg/s^2 f37, upper_arm_l 45607 f29; df1e shin flips f83/86, jump 45.4 cm.

action_items.area: upper-arm twist snaps (new jitter in quiet clips)
action_items.change: With the hinge bias now 4-9 deg, static and slowly moving arms show de-biased elbow bends of 5-20 deg, right inside the 2-10 deg window where the upper-arm twist weight goes 0 -> 1. The twist then snaps by 20-40 deg in 1-2 frames. Widen the window (zero ~15, full ~35 deg, as in v1 A5) and/or low-pass the twist weight; a nearly straight arm should inherit its twist smoothly.
